system.description:
A brass cap: immunity to telepaths reading one's thoughts and to ESP. Each charge lasts one day. Indicator in Ancient Salarvyáni.

Charges: roll d100 when found. Rechargeable with the Thoroughly Useful Eye.

How many exist: one known; possibly several made for the priests of Ksárul. Never for sale, though one may sometimes be borrowed from a temple or the Imperium for a mission.
